name: Esra

services.title: Art Direction
services.description: I help with the creation and development of online advertising ideas, with particular focus on their visual appearance.

services.title: Branding
services.description: I design key brand elements such as the logo, color scheme, typography, and other design components that makes your brand stand out from competitors.

services.title: Special Occasion Design
services.description: I design invitations, brochures, posters, short animations, and social media posts for all your special occasions, such as weddings, engagements, birthdays, and company anniversaries.

services.title: Creative Drawings
services.description: Creative digital illustrations for all your ideas and stories.

aboutpara:
Hi, I'm Esra — a freelance graphic and brand designer who believes design is both a form of art and a powerful business tool. With a foundation in business administration, I approach every project blending creative intuition with strategic thinking. Working primarily with Canva and Procreate, I specialize in crafting social media templates, digital storefront visuals (like Etsy), branding, and creative illustrations.

For me, design is more than arranging visuals — it's about crafting a digital presence that gives your brand a clear voice. I love collaborating with small businesses, creative entrepreneurs, and individual clients to create aesthetics with purpose. If you want your brand's digital story to stand out and carry meaning, I'd love to help you build it.

bio.description: I design memorable visual identities and ready-to-use social media templates for brands and small businesses. Blending the market insight from my business background with design, I help elevate your digital storefronts (Etsy, Instagram, etc.) with aesthetic, purpose-driven visuals.

education.universityPara: I draw on the fundamentals of my business education to understand consumer behavior and market dynamics throughout the design process. Special Training: Advanced Canva and Procreate Digital Design Courses.
